mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates highly accommodative monetary policy, lowering equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 275.0 signals persistent inflation, triggering Fed tightening expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 275.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS increase month-over-month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), labor market weakness suppresses consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2.0% annualized indicates robust economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when GDP growth > 2.0% annualized, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL > 275.0 combined with FEDFUNDS < 0.5% indicates policy misstep in inflation response, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 275.0 AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In strong labor market regimes (PAYEMS growth > 200k), rising employment fuels consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 200k, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
